Italian attempt to sell Bartolomeo Colleoni

The Italian Light Cruiser Bartolomeo Colleoni deployed to the China Station in November 1938. After the outbreak of World War 2, it was proposed to sell her to Japan due to concerns about her ability to return to Europe during the conflict. While negotiations progressed somewhat, they ultimately failed, and the vessel successfully returned to Italy in late 1939.
